description: Get a scene's node hierarchy as a nested tree. maxDepth: 1 lists only direct children; the default -1 is the whole tree. parentPath scopes to one subtree. Returns: the root node { name, type, path, script, children[] }, every child the same shape; path is a root/... node path the node tools accept, script a res:// path or an empty string. A node cut by maxDepth has children null and a childCount, and warnings leads. Errors if the scene or parentPath is not found.

maxDepth.description: Maximum recursion depth. -1 for unlimited (default: -1). 1 returns only direct children.

parentPath.description: Scope to a subtree starting at this node path (e.g. "root/Player")

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene file path relative to the project

name: get_scene_tree

childCount.description: Only when children is null: how many children were not listed.

children.description: Child nodes, each in this same shape. Null when maxDepth stopped the listing at a node that has children; childCount says how many.

path.description: Node path from the scene root in the "root/..." form the node tools accept.

script.description: res:// path of the attached script, or "".

warnings.description: Root node only. Present when maxDepth cut the tree.
